prediction_rule: One-point practical discovery separation, never a significance claim.
discovery_selection: Initial HK seed0 step2500, political original128 episodes, selected before new K/V outcomes.
interpretation: Transplant actual support K/V only. Joint endpoint must reproduce removal and queries remain fixed. Component ordering is not a variance partition or representativeness claim.

discovery_rule_details.component: Positive singleton exceeds other singleton by at least .01 within-AUC.
discovery_rule_details.joint: Both singleton deltas nonpositive while joint delta positive.
discovery_rule_details.otherwise: Ambiguous; stop without testing a forced prediction.
